# CraftLayer session handoff

**Date:** <UTC>. **Agent/session:** <identifier>. **Branch/base/head:** <values>. **Authorized scope:** <chapter/task and any external action limits>.

## Current state

What exists, what changed, what remains unchanged by the task, and implementation versus verification status. Point to the latest chapter review and task IDs.

## Working tree

List task-owned modified/untracked files and any pre-existing unrelated changes. Never erase another session/user's work.

## Checks and evidence

Exact commands, results/exit codes, environment/fixture versions and evidence paths. Separate not-run/blocked checks from passes. Mention any paid/external action only with its explicit authorization context.

## Decisions and blockers

ADR/decision/risk IDs, safe working defaults, user answers still needed and independent work that can continue. Do not invent approval from elapsed time or a previous agent's confidence.

## Next action

One concrete starting task, commands to inspect current state, relevant files and expected outcome. State the next chapter checkpoint and whether further work is authorized. Update docs/delivery/status.md alongside this handoff.
